verdict.rationale: Letta documents an Agent SDK with code-level guidance such as client.createAgent() and session.send()/stream(), plus demo apps. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference with runnable, in-browser examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. SDK docs and demo apps are adjacent material, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
